name: Stella Maris Resort Club & Marina
brand_truth: An old-school Out Island resort club on Long Island's Atlantic shore, between two shorelines, that will fly you in itself.
buyer: Repeat Out Island travellers, divers, bonefishers, older couples (US and Europe), families and small groups renting multi-bedroom houses; planning months ahead.
